records.text: Reference entry: Ember Index — Concept. Definition: It is the cataloguing method that groups kiln tests by the first glaze variable changed, so a failed firing can be compared only with trials that preserved the same clay body.

Reference header: Orbit Weave — Concept. Seminar transcript. Amara Sol reported: \"It is the rehearsal method that alternates a difficult transition with its surrounding measures, so tempo increases do not erase the entry cue.\"

Archive glossary CL-14 states: "For the interval beginning 2019-04-12T09:00:00.000Z and ending exclusively at 2019-09-30T17:45:00.000Z, the concept named Bramble Prism denoted arranging field notes by the observer's distance from the specimen before comparing their certainty."
